strict_ast_fingerprint.identifier_normalization: scope-aware deterministic binding indices; every Name and arg reference resolves to its normalized binding, preserving use-definition relations
strict_ast_fingerprint.literal_normalization: replace literal values by exact Python literal-type markers while preserving container shape and dictionary-key position
preserved: AST node type and field order
assignment, mutation, subscript and alias relations
strict_ast_fingerprint.fingerprint: SHA-256 of canonical JSON AST representation

relaxed_diagnostics.role: diagnostic only; not sufficient by itself to assert dependence

required_synthetic_tests: hold AFFINE operation and a/b/c fixed, vary only variant: rendered source is identical while current kind:variant identity differs
change an option that changes the rendered AST: independent fingerprint must differ
rename bound variables consistently: independent strict fingerprint must remain equal
change literals only: independent strict fingerprint must remain equal
change operator, call, control-flow or use-definition relation: fingerprint must differ
structural_audit.material_violation_rule: any independent strict-AST-equivalent group counted as multiple scientific families, especially across splits, is material; hash inequality cannot override it
structural_audit.resume_rule: qualification may resume only if no material violation is found and no family, seed, schedule, system or gate must change

oracle_audit.definition: family mean of max across K=8 policy means over R=2 minus champion mean
oracle_audit.interpretation: opportunity/upper-bound diagnostic only; a pass alone does not establish repeatable complementarity or selectability
oracle_audit.post_completion_exploratory_transfer: select policy on rollout 0 and evaluate against champion on rollout 1; reverse directions; deterministic frozen bank-order tie break; average both directions; never a gate

family_probability_laws: logit-normal family heterogeneity with SD in {0.5,1.0}
beta family heterogeneity matched to mean p and concentration in {4,12}
power_audit.independent_mechanism: Y_router,t,r ~ Bernoulli(p_router,t) and Y_champion,t,r ~ Bernoulli(p_champion,t) with independent system and rollout RNG streams
checks: whether exact-policy sharing is possible in the frozen final bank
selection_prohibitions: no scenario selection by favorable power
